body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Cobra electronics, a manufacturer of navigation products, presented ''XRS R9G'' during 2007 CES Unveiled. It is a wireless remote controlled radar detector with GPS locator. The locator can alert drivers a fixed red light and speed camera location on the road.
It is expected to be available in U.S. and Canada market around this March.
